XZG_IndexTTS25_ModelLoader.description: Discover and validate the IndexTTS 2.5 model under ComfyUI/models/TTS; weights are loaded on demand at first generation.

model_name.name: IndexTTS 2.5 Model
model_name.tooltip: Standard location: ComfyUI/models/TTS/IndexTTS-2.5. Refresh/restart ComfyUI after installing a model.

precision.name: Precision
precision.tooltip: auto uses bfloat16 on supported GPUs, otherwise float32.

use_qwen_emo.name: Enable Text Emotion Analysis
use_qwen_emo.tooltip: Loads the Qwen emotion model (extra VRAM) to enable the emotion control node's text description mode. Keep off if you don't use it.

use_cuda_kernel.name: BigVGAN CUDA Fused Kernel
use_cuda_kernel.tooltip: May compile an extension on first use; keep off if unsure.

release_after_run.name: Release Model After Run
release_after_run.tooltip: Suitable for low-VRAM environments; lowers speed for consecutive generations.

verify_hashes.name: Full SHA-256 Verification
verify_hashes.tooltip: First verification reads ~5GB of files; otherwise only file sizes are checked.

custom_model_path.name: Custom Model Absolute Path
custom_model_path.tooltip: Leave empty to use the list above; only for existing complete IndexTTS 2.5 directories.

XZG_IndexTTS25_EmotionControl.description: Control emotion in four ways: 8-dimensional vector, emotion reference audio, text description, or follow the voice. The official model ships with 8 emotion dimensions (Happy/Angry/Sad/Afraid/Disgusted/Melancholic/Surprised/Calm).

mode.name: Emotion Mode
mode.tooltip: text loads an additional Qwen emotion model on demand.

use_random.name: Random Emotion Prototype
use_random.tooltip: When on, the seed determines the prototype for each emotion; when off, matches the voice reference.

emotion_text.name: Emotion Description
emotion_text.placeholder: e.g. happy: brisk pace with a light laugh; sad: slow pace with a trembling voice; low and suppressed, slightly melancholic; shouting with surprise and excitement. Leave blank to analyze the text to synthesize.

XZG_IndexTTS25_SamplingConfig.description: Centrally configure determinism, sampling, long-text segmentation, pauses and text normalization parameters.

do_sample.name: Enable Random Sampling
do_sample.tooltip: Results are more stable when off; temperature/top_p/top_k take effect when on.

XZG_IndexTTS25_Generate.description: Multilingual zero-shot voice cloning with the IndexTTS 2.5 model, outputting standard ComfyUI AUDIO.

emotion.name: Emotion Control
emotion.tooltip: Follows the voice reference when not connected.

sampling.name: Sampling Config
sampling.tooltip: Uses stable defaults when not connected.
